content:
Apple is rolling out a new round of RC (release candidate) versions for its upcoming software updates, including iPadOS 26.6, watchOS 26.6, and more. Here is what you can expect.

The arrival of the RC version indicates that Apple's 26.6 updates are about to be officially released.

Apple's major new software versions, including iOS 27, iPadOS 27, and macOS Golden Gate, are expected to launch in the fall.

However, even sooner than that, a new round of updates in the "OS 26" cycle is on the way.

iOS 26.6, iPadOS 26.6, macOS 26.6, and others are set to arrive very shortly, with the RC versions of these updates also officially released today.

Apple has issued RC versions for its entire lineup of upcoming 26.6 updates, including iPadOS 26.6, watchOS 26.6, tvOS 26.6, and more.

The RC version is released at the end of the beta testing period and is intended to be identical to the software version that will later be officially released to the public.

However, Apple occasionally discovers other bugs that require last-minute modified RC versions to incorporate fixes.

In any case, since the RC versions of Apple's 26.6 updates are ready, these new versions should be officially released in about a week or so.

Based on the current beta cycle, these updates appear to focus mainly on under-the-hood improvements rather than new features. But if there are any new developments, we will continue to keep you updated.

Have you spotted anything new in Apple's 26.6 software updates or the RC versions? Feel free to share with us in the comments section.
